title: Family with 9-Month-Old Baby by Picket Fence, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-century black-and-white deckle-edge snapshot showing a young family crouched beside their white wood-sided house and white picket fence. The mother and father smile gently as they support their nine-month-old child, who is dressed in overalls. Hand-inscribed '9 Mos' on the top-left border, the image exemplifies the optimistic domesticity and rapid suburban growth of postwar America in the 1950s.
